speaker: richard_burbage
text: Will? Dick Burbage. From Holywell, and I heard you were in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dick. I am in. The last mile was this morning, with the pack on my own shoulder, for the look of it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The marshal's men are off the gates. The Rose's men are back, and they open Monday, and so do we, the same afternoon, and let the town choose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday. I heard the bills at the Bell, from Gilbert, off a post in Fleet Street.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: That is half of it. The other half is Verona. I want every leaf, tonight. I have had a month with nothing to do but learn, and I am hungry for a scene that is not a crown.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sunday. After church. Thou shalt have the orchard.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have had the king's roll five days. There is a hole in it at the fold where the crown goes. Garnish says he will not write me another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then con it by the hole.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: God keep thee, Will. Walk in like a man with a back, Monday. The yard will want to see thee.
